functionDeclarations.name: youtube_action
functionDeclarations.description: Control YouTube in the paired Chrome extension. Search for and play a video, choose a numbered search result, or pause/resume playback. Search may return needs_selection with candidateId values; ask the user which numbered video they want, then call select_and_play with that candidateId. Report actual status only. Pause and resume restore the previously used tab and window.

query.description: Video title or search terms. Required for search_and_play.

candidateId.description: Exact candidateId from a previous needs_selection response. Required for select_and_play.

targetTitle.description: Optional video title to disambiguate pause or resume when more than one YouTube video is open.
